hero.title: Better maternal care, connected.
hero.subtitle: MamaCare Rwanda connects mothers, families, community health workers and healthcare teams to support healthier pregnancy and newborn care.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.description: Sign up in your preferred language, English or Kinyarwanda.

steps.title: Follow your journey
steps.description: See your pregnancy week, upcoming appointments, and daily reminders.

steps.title: Stay connected
steps.description: Your community health worker and care team stay informed and reachable.

mothers.title: For mothers
mothers.description: A clear picture of your pregnancy, your next steps, and trusted health information — in one place.

families.title: For families
families.description: Partners and family members can support with the things that matter, when the mother chooses to share.

chw.title: For community health workers
chw.description: See who needs follow-up, at a glance, so no one falls through the cracks.

officers.title: For healthcare teams
officers.description: Aggregated, privacy-conscious visibility into community-level maternal health trends.

privacy.title: Privacy and safety
privacy.description: Your health information is sensitive. MamaCare Rwanda uses role-based access so only the right people see the right information, and you control what is shared with a partner.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Join MamaCare Rwanda today — it's free.

disclaimer: MamaCare Rwanda supports the work of community health workers and healthcare professionals. It does not diagnose conditions or replace professional medical care.
